description: One recursively indexed JSON object member. Identity consists of parent_id, decoded key, and a nonnegative occurrence disambiguator.

columns.name: container_id
columns.description: Stable, nonempty child-container identity unique within the file. Fresh imports derive it from parent_id, key, and occurrence; SQL may supply an identity and retain it across renames and moves. Present only for object or array values.

columns.name: empty_json
columns.description: Exact whitespace inside this member's empty object or array value. Omitted for non-empty containers and scalars.

columns.name: key
columns.description: The decoded JSON object member name; RFC 6901 escaping is not part of identity.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: The JSON value kind represented by this member.

columns.name: occurrence
columns.description: Zero-based occurrence of this decoded key on import. Defaults to zero for ordinary unique-key SQL inserts. Preserved across SQL edits; file observations reassign occurrences by source order.

columns.name: order_key
columns.description: Lexically sorted lowercase hex bytes, nonempty with an even length and no trailing 00. Defaults to 80; equal keys sort by member key and occurrence, not insertion time.

columns.name: parent_id
columns.description: Stable identity of the containing object.

columns.name: prefix_json
columns.description: Exact whitespace, encoded object key, colon, and following whitespace immediately before the value. Omitted for the compact canonical key spelling.

columns.name: scalar_json
columns.description: The JSON scalar value. Omitted when kind is object or array.

columns.name: scalar_text
columns.description: Exact noncanonical scalar spelling, used only while it agrees with scalar_json.

columns.name: suffix_json
columns.description: Exact whitespace after the value and before its comma or closing brace. Omitted when empty.
